Fresh numbers, even when you don't use the terminal.

## What's new

- **Codex limits stay current on their own.** Every 5 minutes, and whenever you open the window, honeybee asks your installed Codex for its limits. No prompt is sent, so it uses none of your allowance, and Codex does its own signing in.
- **Keep Claude numbers live from VS Code.** Claude Code shares its limits only from a terminal, never from the VS Code panel. When Claude's numbers are old, honeybee offers to turn on the extension's **Use Terminal** setting for you (or use the switch in settings). It changes that one line in VS Code's `settings.json`, keeps your file as `settings.json.before-honeybee`, and works for Cursor, Windsurf and VS Code Insiders too.

## Install

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `honeybee-4.2.0-win-x64-setup.exe`, or `…-portable.exe` |
| macOS Apple silicon | `honeybee-4.2.0-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `honeybee-4.2.0-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Linux x64 / arm64 | `.AppImage` or `.deb` |

The builds are unsigned. On Windows choose **More info → Run anyway**. On macOS right-click → **Open**.
